name: AstroCubeVR
summary:
**AstroCubeVR** — immersive 3D exploration of astronomical datacubes, from Immersive Science.

Load FITS datacubes from ALMA and other radio telescopes and navigate through them in true 3D on Meta Quest.

**Interactive measurement**
- Measure distances directly in RA/Dec coordinates
- Real-time coordinate display with velocity at each point
- Automatic frequency-to-velocity conversion via Doppler formula
- Labels render clearly on top of volume data

**Multi-channel spectral lines**
- Load and compare CO, H
